task: How should kogitsune's config selector be built so it is both accurate and fast?
rationale: Fixing haiku harness latency is a dead-end under OAuth; make model calls RARE via teacher(opus)->student(skill) distillation, logging every opus decision as a gold label. Tier 0 learned skill / Tier 1 haiku --bare / Tier 2 opus full-catalog compose.

alternatives.why_not: needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY which this host lacks; only cuts per-call cost, not call frequency
brittle, no learning loop, ceiling too low for composition decisions

task: add JWT refresh tokens to our Python auth service with tests

decision.launch: kit build -- "add JWT refresh tokens to our Python auth service with tests"

rationale: Security-sensitive Python feature with tests needs full ECC review capability + superpowers TDD methodology; language rules pack for python.

alternatives.why_not: has process discipline but lacks python reviewers/security agents
lighter; fine if no security surface, but auth raises the bar to build

task: fix a typo in the README

decision.launch: kit lean -- "fix a typo in the README"

rationale: Trivial docs edit needs no harness; leanest kit. This is exactly the case a learned student skill should short-circuit with zero model call.

alternatives.why_not: process overhead unjustified for a typo
